:::{#exm-deriv-matrix-vector}
#### Vector-derivative of a matrix-vector product

Let $\matr{A} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 3 \end{pmatrix}$ ($1 \times 2$, constant)
and $\vecf{v}(\vb) = \tp{(\beta_1^2, \beta_2^2)}$.
Then $\matr{A}\vecf{v} = 2\beta_1^2 + 3\beta_2^2$.
By @thm-deriv-matrix-vector:

$$
\ba
\underbrace{\deriv{\vb}(\matr{A}\vecf{v})}_{2 \times 1}
&= \begin{pmatrix} 2\beta_1 & 0 \\
0 & 2\beta_2 \end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix} 2 \\
3 \end{pmatrix} \\
&= \begin{pmatrix} 4\beta_1 \\
6\beta_2 \end{pmatrix}
\ea
$$

:::
